summary.en: Read PDF pages, spreadsheet sheets and ranges (xlsx, csv) and Word paragraphs (docx) with exact page, sheet, cell and paragraph references.
summary.ru: Читать страницы PDF, листы и диапазоны таблиц (xlsx, csv) и абзацы Word (docx) с точными ссылками на страницу, лист, ячейку и абзац.

required.name: files.read
required.reason: to read the document from the workspace

tools.name: info
tools.summary: What a document holds: its type, pages, sheets with their used ranges, paragraph or row count.

tools.name: read
tools.summary: Read part of a document with references: PDF pages ('1-3,7'), a sheet and A1 range ('B2:F40'), CSV rows ('1-100') or DOCX paragraphs ('10-30').

sheet.description: Spreadsheet sheet name; defaults to the first.

range.description: A1 range for xlsx (B2:F40), or rows/paragraphs for csv/docx (1-100).
